schema_version.description: Schema version of the report; this schema accepts version 6 [rule].

document.description: Kind of report document emitted by this schema [rule].

source.description: How the analyzed position was supplied: FEN or PGN [rule].

fen.description: Full FEN of the analyzed position [rule].

pgn_game.description: 1-based PGN game number, or null for FEN input [rule].

pgn_ply.description: Half-moves played from the game's start position, or null for FEN input [rule].

moves.description: The --moves value exactly as supplied, or null when no moves were requested [rule].

selection.description: Normalized move selection used to size Search A and choose reported moves [rule].

keywords.description: Selected keywords in the fixed enum order, each once [rule].

top.description: Largest topN selection, or null when no topN was given [rule].

moves.description: Asked move UCIs in typed order, each once [rule].

engine.description: Engine identity, settings, and search accounting [engine].

name.description: Engine name reported by UCI id name [engine].

multipv.description: MultiPV width K requested for candidate search [engine].

reproducible.description: same configuration (budget, threads, hash, nodes) gives the same report

nodes.description: Configured node budget for each search kind [rule].

A.description: Scaled node budget for MultiPV K from the current position [rule].

B.description: Node budget for the null-move search with the opponent to move [rule].

C.description: Node budget for the searchmoves m search for an asked move outside A [rule].

D.description: Node budget for the search after m restricted to the opponent's threat move [rule].

E.description: Node budget for the search after m with a null move [rule].

R.description: Node budget for the search after m excluding the refutation's first move [rule].

nodes_searched.description: Sum of nodes reported by every engine search run [engine].

position.description: Facts about the analyzed board and its rule-derived features [rule].

fen.description: Full FEN of the analyzed board [rule].

side_to_move.description: Side to move on the analyzed board [rule].

in_check.description: Whether the side to move is in check [rule].

legal_moves.description: Number of legal moves on the analyzed board [rule].

terminal.description: Terminal state, or null when the position is nonterminal [rule].

eval_white.description: Best line evaluation from search A, from White's point of view; null iff terminal [engine].

motifs.description: Tactical motifs present on the board at ply 0 [rule].

positional.description: Positional features present on the board at ply 0 [rule].

threats.description: Threat searches and urgency for the analyzed position; null iff terminal [engine/rule].

white.description: Threat found for White, or null when none is reported [engine].

black.description: Threat found for Black, or null when none is reported [engine].

null_move_reliable.description: Whether the null-move search is reliable, or null when the rule cannot decide [rule].

source.description: Provenance of the null-move reliability value [rule].

value.description: Reliability result, or null when the side to move is in check [rule].

urgency.description: Rule-derived ordering of which side's threat is more urgent [rule].

more_urgent.description: Side with the more urgent threat, or null iff the urgency rule is quiet [rule].

rule.description: Rule used to determine threat urgency [rule].

candidates.description: Engine's top legal moves in MultiPV order; empty for terminal positions [engine].

playable_truncated.description: true iff Search A returned all K lines, K is less than legal moves, and every A line is playable [rule].

asked_moves.description: Asked moves outside Search A, assessed by Search C in typed order [engine].

opening.description: Opening-book identification for the analyzed position [book].

dataset.description: Shipped opening dataset ID or custom@ plus the first 12 SHA-256 hex digits [book].

current.description: Opening name for the analyzed position, or null when unnamed [book].

last_named.description: Last named position on the PGN mainline up to the analyzed ply, or null [book].

eco.description: ECO code of the last named opening position [book].

name.description: Opening name at the last named position [book].

ply.description: Half-move number of the last named position [book].

games.description: Game-count results from the configured games table [games].

eco.description: ECO code of a named opening position [book].

name.description: Name of the opening at this position [book].

es.description: Expected score W + D/2 from the containing field's side to move, in [0, 1] [engine].

cp.description: Centipawn score for display, or null when the score is a mate [engine].

mate.description: Mate distance in moves, positive when this side mates, or null otherwise [engine].

mate_in.description: Mate distance in plies, set iff class is mate [rule].

material.description: Net material gain in pawn units for the threatening side over plies [rule].

promotes.description: Whether the threatening side promotes within the consequence line [rule].

plies.description: Number of threat-line plies consumed by the consequence rule [rule].

root_fen.description: FEN at the root of the threat search [engine].

line.description: SAN moves in the engine's threat line [engine].

consequence.description: Rule-derived consequence of the threat line [rule].

motifs.description: Tactical motifs in the threat line [rule].

is_tactic.description: Whether this is a refutation of a move that allows a tactic; null unless a refutation [rule].

opportunity.description: Opportunity judgement for a judged line, or null [engine/rule].

tactic_labels.description: Rule-derived labels for this tactic line; empty otherwise [rule].

san.description: Standard algebraic notation for the move [engine].

eval.description: Score evaluation for this move from the side to move's point of view [engine].

depth.description: Search depth of the line that gave eval: the MultiPV line or search C [engine].

loss.description: Loss from the best candidate's expected score, in [0, 1] [engine].

verdict.description: Verdict from loss, exact score equality, and whether the move allows a tactic [engine].

in_multipv.description: Whether this move was included in the MultiPV search [engine].

line.description: SAN line from the current position, starting with this move, up to 10 plies [engine].

walked_plies.description: Number of line plies from which motif and positional facts were read [rule].

consequence.description: Rule-derived consequence of this move's own line from the analyzed position [rule].

is_tactic.description: Whether this move's own line has consequence class mate or material [rule].

allows_tactic.description: Whether the move loses at least one pawn net or is mated along its own line [rule].

detailed.description: Whether Search D, E and R were run for this selected or first-five line [rule].

parries_threat.description: Whether this move parries the opponent's threat, or null when no class-mate/material threat exists or the side to move is in check [rule].

source.description: Provenance of the parry result: engine for a searched test, rule for a legality test [engine/rule].

value.description: the opponent's threat no longer wins against the pass baseline

test.description: How parrying the threat was tested [engine/rule].

creates_threat.description: Threat found after this move, or null when the search is skipped [engine].

creates_threat_skipped.description: Rule reason the created-threat search was skipped; null iff creates_threat is set [rule].

refutation.description: Opponent's refutation line, set iff verdict is not playable [engine].

motifs.description: Tactical motifs in the move line [rule].

opportunity.description: Opportunity judgement for A's first line, or null [engine/rule].

tactic_labels.description: Rule-derived labels for this tactic line; empty otherwise [rule].

root_motifs.description: Position motifs with contributions judged against this tactic line [rule].

positional.description: Positional feature changes along this move line [rule].

square.description: Board square occupied by the piece [rule].

piece.description: FEN piece letter: uppercase for White and lowercase for Black [rule].

side.description: Side that benefits from the motif [rule].

ply.description: Ply where the motif occurs; 0 denotes the line's root board [rule].

actor.description: Motif actor piece on its board square [rule].

targets.description: Pieces involved in the motif, in the tag-specific order [rule].

gain.description: static exchange (SEE) value in pawn units

threat.description: Threat enabled by a pin_tactical motif, or null for other tags [rule].

restriction.description: Held-piece movement restriction, set iff tag is pin_absolute, pin_relative, overloaded_defender, or pin_tactical [rule].

piece.description: Held piece h as it stands on the motif's board [rule].

restricted.description: Denied moves of the held piece on the motif board, as ascending UCI strings; non-empty [rule].

free.description: Other legal moves of the held piece on the motif board, as ascending UCI strings [rule].

held_to.description: Movement constraint inferred from distinct free-move destinations; never null [rule].

kind.description: Geometric form of the movement constraint [rule].

name.description: File, rank, edge-to-edge diagonal, square, or ascending comma-separated squares naming the constraint [rule].

contribution.description: Motif's contribution to the tactic, or null when not judged [rule].

kind.description: Kind of threat enabled by the tactical pin [rule].

square.description: Square where the enabled threat is created [rule].

actor.description: Capturing piece on its destination square [rule].

targets.description: Captured defender followed by the piece it defended [rule].

source.description: Provenance of the opportunity judgement: engine, or rule iff the line is forced [engine/rule].

forced.description: Whether the judged line's root has exactly one legal move [rule].

alternative.description: Best alternative first move, or null iff the line is forced [engine].

san.description: Standard algebraic notation for the alternative move [engine].

uci.description: UCI encoding of the alternative move [engine].

eval.description: Expected-score evaluation of the alternative from the judged line's side point of view [engine].

margin.description: Expected-score margin of the line over its best alternative, or null iff forced [engine].

is_opportunity.description: Whether the only-move margin is at least 0.13 expected score [engine].

side.description: Side that owns the positional feature [rule].

pieces.description: Pieces describing the feature, in the tag-specific order [rule].

file.description: File associated with the feature, or null when it has no file [rule].

value.description: Tag-specific positional value, or null when the tag has no value [rule].

ply.description: Ply where the feature appears or disappears [rule].

change.description: Whether the feature appears on P_k or disappears from P_k-1 [rule].

holds_at_end.description: Whether the feature still holds at the end of the line [rule].

tag.description: Tag of the positional feature that changed [rule].

side.description: Side that owns the positional feature [rule].

pieces.description: Pieces describing the feature, in the tag-specific order [rule].

file.description: File associated with the feature, or null when it has no file [rule].

value.description: Tag-specific positional value, or null when the tag has no value [rule].

by_source.description: Game-count results for each configured source [games].

table.description: Shipped games-table ID or custom@ plus the first 12 SHA-256 hex digits [games].

platform.description: Platform represented by the source's table [games].

players.description: Player rating criterion represented by the source's table [games].

months.description: Date range represented by the source's table [games].

credit.description: Credit and license information for the source data [games].

max_ply.description: Maximum searched half-move count in the source's table [games].

min_games.description: Minimum game count required for a move to be listed [games].

found.description: Whether the analyzed position was found in the source table [games].

games.description: Total games for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

white.description: White wins for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

draws.description: Draws for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

black.description: Black wins for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

moves.description: Moves from the analyzed position and their game counts [games].

san.description: Standard algebraic notation of the move from the analyzed position [games].

uci.description: UCI encoding of the move from the analyzed position [games].

games.description: Number of source games that played this move [games].
